content.title: Chicago Bulls at Oklahoma City Thunder - Where to Watch, Stream Info, TV Channel, and Live Updates (March 27, 2026)
content.text: The Chicago Bulls will face off against the Oklahoma City Thunder in a matchup that highlights a stark contrast in team performance this season. The Bulls enter the game with a record of 29-43, struggling in the conference with a 17-29 mark and currently on a one-game losing streak. In contrast, the Thunder boast an impressive 57-16 record, leading their division and holding a strong 37-9 conference record, although they too are coming off a loss. Key players for the Thunder include Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, who leads the team with 31.5 points per game, while the Bulls’ top scorer is Coby White, averaging 18.6 points per game. Both teams will look to rebound from their recent defeats as they meet at the Paycom Center.
